axis_coverage.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axis_coverage.analysis: The final is a complete proposal for the hypothetical building, not a diagnosis or renovation design. It keeps courtyard disturbance and room sound separate, compares source/scheduling controls with existing-panel relocation and conditional source/path concepts, includes a low-cost log, logs no-drum/no-session/background events, investigates the winter rearrangement, and states three real implementation contexts and differences. No new site material, complaint count, measurement, legal threshold, enforcement or permanent installation is recommended. Missing geometry/access/metric/instrument inputs and their consequences remain explicit.

axis_coverage.name: Consequential source claims and exact applicability
axis_coverage.analysis: Independently retrieved all 12 cited primary identities. ISO scopes/editions/status, conditional 50 Hz model extension, Hopkins 50/63/80 Hz room-average repeatability, FHWA sensor/path limitations, three case contexts, and SR11 load/shape-factor/condition disclaimer support the bounded uses made. The Gjers 5 dB is a Dw rating change, not 5 dBA receiver attenuation; final's neutral wording preserves that distinction. Emslie outdoor comparison is expressly unmatched. The candidate never promotes an abstract, datasheet or indoor recording to a site efficacy oracle.
limits: Some supporting scientific and standards records are abstracts/catalogue scopes only. That suffices for the bounded summaries here; full procedures/product implementation remain unverified.
Emslie numeric levels are identified only as dBA in final prose, rather than explicitly LA10. The central noncomparability caveat and independent receiver design prevent a material misuse.
The inherited map has a stale critic scope label and a relative critic source-index pointer; final's own index and top-level source_index correctly navigate the actual evidence.

axis_coverage.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, competing/analogous approaches, implementation/history and breadth
axis_coverage.analysis: The research does substantive discovery: flexible airbed reverberation control with actual hall/laboratory history, a drum platform measured with two slab zones and mixed vibration results, a detailed drum-studio history including abandoned masonry, weakest roof and daily gap/bridge inspection, room microphone-position issues, and absorber placement effects. These are used to formulate discriminating questions rather than as site predictions. The alternatives span source settings/time, source relocation, existing panel crossover, conditional targeted absorption/isolation, and a log/background attribution first deliverable. Dated rearrangement records/interviews and simultaneous repairs/hours/equipment changes are explicit opportunities.
limits: Detailed airbed model/installation bands, this site's instrument history, and load/support design are not known and are not selected.
The proposal need not enumerate every possible mechanism or adopt tapping-machine impact criteria; the chosen source/event pilot has an appropriate distinct oracle.

axis_coverage.name: Wrong criticisms/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axis_coverage.analysis: Assessed each criticism independently. The vibration correction is sound: absence is not informative without adequate measurement coverage. The Emslie clarification is supported by the original primary paper's distinct baseline/post-build positions and source contexts. Neither amendment introduces a new material false claim. All remaining critique classes and positive coverage/handoff are explicitly disposed; no criticism is silently rejected or scope cut. The full exact-clause register independently assesses every sentence/bullet in the plan's content paragraphs, including original brief, permissions/metric/frequency/budget owner choices, and release/authoring statements. Release prerequisites that cannot be authenticated from this bounded packet are marked UNKNOWN rather than assumed.

axis_coverage.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery, draft, critique and final
axis_coverage.analysis: The final retains the supported causal hypotheses, mixed/background alternatives, option breadth, room-rearrangement/history questions, receiver distinction, one-meter fallback limitations, uncertainty, prospective A/B/C comparisons, and actual desk-only status. It incorporates both specific corrections without substituting a change list for a proposal. Detailed standards ranges and Song diminishing-return/overdamping information are compressed in final prose but preserved in the retained source map; the final selects neither a formal insulation procedure nor an absorber quantity based on these compressed details.

axis_coverage.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axis_coverage.analysis: The proposed pilot has reference/source/optional panel conditions, repeated comparable passages, order counterbalancing, independently observed courtyard and room outcomes, no-session/background periods, instrument capability/calibration/time checks, deviations/confounders, and resident-tied decisions assessed against uncertainty. One meter yields lower-confidence matched separate blocks, expressly no same-event transmission loss; a context recorder is not calibrated SPL. Source covariance is not a path verdict; sound/vibration channels with adequate coupling and coverage would be needed for later structural attribution. The final does not claim a field pilot, calculations, simulation, product validation or measurements occurred. Desk source checks are evidence about the literature, not an oracle for this building.
